title: 'Plan my day' with e-mail, calendar and the shop's order system (shop owner, Manchester) → a timed plan that merges meetings, the late order and the e-mail deadline
description: Mesma capacidade do ouro 15 (plano do dia juntando agenda e e-mail), outro contexto: lojista de e-commerce no Reino Unido (en-US, GBP, 'Nov 6') que usa um ERP fictício (`orderdesk`, tools `list_orders`/`update_order_status`/`refund_order`) além de e-mail e agenda. O ERP não é conhecido do runtime: o bot só pode usá-lo pelo conector. O plano é só de leitura (nada de atualizar pedido, reembolsar, enviar ou rascunhar) e ignora a promoção.

source.note: Conjunto genérico F0.7 (PLANO-AGENTE-V4/04-avaliacao.md §1.1): cenário sintético com pessoa, loja e contexto fictícios (domínios .test), para o motor não viciar no uso do dono.

bot.name: Leo
bot.about: Personal assistant for a small online shop: orders, suppliers, e-mail and calendar.

tools.name: fetch_mails
tools.description: Search the user's e-mails. Returns id, sender, subject and a short snippet (not the full body).

responses.text: {"messages":[{"id":"z1","from":"payouts@paylark.test","subject":"Your payout is on hold","snippet":"Action needed to release your payout."},{"id":"z2","from":"orders@brightbox.test","subject":"Your packaging order: delivery window","snippet":"Delivery details inside."},{"id":"z3","from":"deals@supplyhub.test","subject":"Black Friday supplier sale: up to 40% off","snippet":"Stock up early."}]}

tools.name: read_mail
tools.description: Read the full body of one e-mail by id.

responses.text: {"id":"z1","from":"payouts@paylark.test","subject":"Your payout is on hold","body":"Your payout of £1,284.60 is on hold until you confirm your bank details in the dashboard. Please do it by Nov 6 or the payout moves to the next cycle."}

{"id":"z2","from":"orders@brightbox.test","subject":"Your packaging order: delivery window","body":"Your packaging order arrives tomorrow between 8:00 and 12:00. Someone must be at the shop to sign for it."}

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Create an e-mail draft (does not send).

tools.name: forward_mail
tools.description: Forward an e-mail to another address.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List calendar events of a day.

responses.text: {"events":[{"time":"09:30-10:00","title":"Courier pickup (Parcelway)"},{"time":"12:00-13:00","title":"Lunch with Imogen"},{"time":"15:00-15:45","title":"Call with the packaging supplier (Brightbox)"}]}

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List the shop's orders by status. Returns id, status, age in days, customer and total.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.description: Change the status of one order.

expect.rubric: The plan is a chronological sequence that respects the fixed calendar events (courier pickup, lunch, supplier call), fits the overdue order OD-4821 before the courier pickup, places the payout bank-details confirmation (by Nov 6) and the packaging delivery tomorrow, and ends with what can wait. It is not just a list of events and e-mails.

turns.say:
Your day:

- 08:30 Pack order OD-4821 (3 days waiting, the oldest) and OD-4825 so both are ready for the courier
- 09:30 Courier pickup (Parcelway)
- 10:15 Confirm your bank details in the PayLark dashboard: the £1,284.60 payout stays on hold unless you do it by Nov 6
- 12:00 Lunch with Imogen
- 14:00 Look at OD-4826 (payment failed, £112.00) and decide whether to contact the customer
- 15:00 Call with the packaging supplier (Brightbox)

Tomorrow: the packaging delivery arrives between 8:00 and 12:00 and someone has to sign for it. I did not change any order or send anything.
